{{Quote|Recently, our researchers uncovered several "teaching holograms," but they've not been fully studied. These holograms may be records of the founders of the Jedi Order--they're absolutely irreplaceable.|Jedi Master Yuon Par briefs her Padawan on Tython|<ref name="The Path of a Jedi" />}}
The '''teaching holograms''' were a series of [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] devices that housed the knowledge of several founding [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]: [[Cala Brin]], [[Rajivari]], [[Garon Jard]], and [[Ters Sendon]]. They were located on bridges in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the holograms became threatened by [[Flesh Raider]]s, and the [[The Barsen'thor|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] was sent to retrieve the holograms. However, Rajivari's hologram had already been taken by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Nalen Raloch]].

==Behind the scenes==
The holograms appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and are the subject of the [[Jedi Consular]] mission "Path of the Jedi." The order that the holograms are found in can vary, but the order of the identities of the projections remains the same&mdash;Garon Jard, Cala Brin, Ters Sendon, and finally the missing hologram of Rajivari.
